stem: Find the point of intersection of the circle $x^2+y^2=10$ and the line $y=3x-10$. Plot it.
solution: The line touches the circle at $(3,-1)$.

hints.text: The x value comes first; find y by putting x into the line.
Recheck the signs when you substitute x into the line.
Substitute the line into the circle and simplify to a quadratic in x; look at its roots.
